findings.description: Switching the match guard to `is not None` also accepts an empty pattern `match=""`, which previously raised TypeError. The empty pattern then matches every exception string, so the retrier silently retries all exceptions.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="") with message left as None. Before this change, the check `not message and not match` raised TypeError because match was falsy. After it, match is not None, so construction succeeds and self.match = re.compile(""). In _check, self.message is None, so self.match.match(str(exception)) returns a match for any string, and every exception is retried. The title only announces accepting an empty message, not an empty match pattern, so this is an unintended behavior change that turns a configuration error into silent over-retrying.
